Data Engineer with hands-on experience building data pipelines and analytics-ready datasets. Focused on reliable ETL orchestration, performant SQL modeling, and scalable processing on cloud infrastructure. Open to relocation anywhere in India.

Experience
Zoho — Apr 2025 - Mar 2026
Data Engineer, Remote
- Implemented PySpark jobs to transform raw event streams into partitioned Parquet tables, reducing downstream query latency by 45% while processing ~150M records/day; used Python 3 for job logic and PySpark for distributed processing.
- Designed and optimized SQL models and dbt transformations to standardize metrics across product teams, cutting dashboard build time by 35% and improving data consistency for BI consumers.
- Built AWS-based data infrastructure using S3 for raw/processed storage and EMR for batch processing; automated deployments and environment configuration to lower manual setup time by 60%.
- Orchestrated workflows with Apache Airflow for dependency management and scheduled jobs, integrating retries and alerting under Agile sprint cadence to maintain 99.8% pipeline uptime.

Projects
- Ad hoc customer segmentation pipeline: Developed end-to-end pipeline using PySpark and SQL to generate weekly customer cohorts stored in S3; enabled marketing to target segments with a 12% uplift in campaign engagement.
- Cost monitoring dashboard: Created SQL-backed reports and dbt models to track ETL cost per pipeline on AWS, identifying optimizations that reduced monthly processing costs by ~18%.

Skills
Languages: Python 3, SQL
Orchestration & Modeling: Apache Airflow, dbt
Cloud & Processing: AWS, PySpark
Methodologies: Agile
